title: GTA 6 Midnight Launch Plans Have Fans Ready for the New Zealand Trick
description: With Rockstar setting GTA 6 to launch at midnight local time on November 19, fans are already planning to change their console regions to play early.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Midnight Local Launch Paves the Way for Time Zone Tricks

As the release of Rockstar Games' highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 approaches, excitement continues to reach unprecedented heights. According to recent reports, Rockstar will launch the game at midnight local time in most countries on November 19. This rollout method means that players around the globe will enter the game sequentially based on their local time zones, rather than waiting for a single simultaneous global release moment.

This specific launch structure has immediately triggered a wave of anticipation and strategic planning within the console gaming community. Veteran players are already looking back at time-tested methods used during previous major digital releases. Because certain regions across the globe hit midnight much earlier than others, fans are actively discussing how they might adjust their console regions to match those ahead-of-the-curve time zones.

## The Classic New Zealand Console Trick Returns

For years, adjusting console settings or account regions to New Zealand—affectionately dubbed the "New Zealand trick" by the community—has been a popular method for enthusiastic players aiming to jump into major titles a few hours ahead of their local schedules. Given that New Zealand sits significantly ahead in standard global time zones, players residing there, or those clever enough to temporarily adopt the region on their systems, often secure the earliest access to digital launches.

With November 19 locked in as the launch window featuring a midnight local time rollout, players across social media and gaming forums have already begun plotting whether the classic region-shifting strategy will work smoothly for GTA 6. While actual platform-specific restrictions and store account verifications will ultimately dictate how effective these attempts are on launch day, the mere existence of these plans highlights the extraordinary level of dedication and eagerness surrounding the title.

## Looking Ahead to November 19

As the industry counts down the months and weeks to November 19, the logistical details of regional rollouts will remain a hot topic of conversation. Midnight local launches always create rolling waves of player activity across the globe, testing network infrastructures and generating non-stop discussion online as each time zone crosses the threshold.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's choice of a midnight local launch is a great way to let players experience day-one excitement at a natural hour, but it inevitably revives the legendary New Zealand console trick. Whether or not changing console regions ends up working seamlessly on launch night, the fact that fans are already strategizing ways to play a few hours early proves just how massive the cultural footprint of GTA 6 truly is.
